parameters.name: Platforms
parameters.description:
构建镜像架构，取值：

- `linux/amd64`

-  `linux/arm64`

- `linux/386`

- `linux/arm/v7`

- `linux/arm/v6`

默认值：`linux/amd64`

parameters.name: PushType
parameters.description:
推送类型，取值：

- `GIT_TAG`：TAG触发

- `GIT_BRANCH`：分支触发

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-repo-build-rule --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-id crr-tquyps22md8p0000 --dockerfile-location / --dockerfile-name Dockerfile --push-type GIT_BRANCH --push-name master --image-tag v0.9.5 --build-rule-id crbr-ly77w5i3t31f0000 --build-args UserName=Test --platforms linux/amd64 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateRepoBuildRule --region cn-hangzhou --PushType GIT_BRANCH --ImageTag 'v0.9.5' --BuildRuleId 'crbr-ly77w5i3t31f0000' --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --BuildArgs.1 'UserName=Test' --PushName master --DockerfileLocation '/' --Platforms.1 'linux/amd64' --RepoId 'crr-tquyps22md8p0000' --DockerfileName Dockerfile
